ios.desc:
Be there even when you're not. The CBS Sports App is everything a sports fan needs in one place. Get personalized alerts for your favorite teams, players and leagues, follow every play with GameTracker, stream live games from CBS and Paramount+, and stay on top of the biggest news in sports. With the CBS Sports App, you can watch the NFL on CBS, UEFA Champions League, Big Ten football and basketball, the Masters, and more via your TV provider or Paramount+ subscription.

All sports. One app. With the CBS Sports App, you'll get:
- The fastest scores and breaking news across every major league, so you're always the first to know
- GameTrackers for the games you can't watch: play-by-play, win probability, drive charts, box scores and the latest betting odds
- An experience built around your fandom: your teams front and center on every screen, alerts for what you actually care about, and the ability to see what you want and hide what you don't
- Live chat with fans who care as much as you do, so you never watch alone
- Personalized news, instant highlights and reactions from your favorite teams, leagues and athletes
- Live CBS and Paramount+ events including NFL on CBS, UEFA Champions League and Europa League, the Masters, Big Ten football and basketball, PGA Championship, Serie A, EFL, NWSL, PGA Tour, WNBA and more*
- CBS Sports HQ, a free 24/7 sports channel with news, highlights, live analysis and onsite coverage from the biggest sports events
- CBS Sports Golazo Network, a free 24/7 soccer channel with live matches, exclusive studio shows like Morning Footy, news, highlights, documentaries and more
- A 24/7 stream of CBS Sports Network, the cable home of CBS Sports*
- Expert picks and betting analysis from SportsLine insiders
- Free-to-play games all year: March Madness and UEFA Champions League brackets, weekly football picks and UFC Pick'em for every numbered event. Compete with friends. Win prizes.

Fans live here. All sports, one app. Free to download.

*Available via login with a participating TV provider and/or Paramount+ subscription.

Please note: The CBS Sports app features Nielsen's proprietary measurement software which contributes to market research, like Nielsen's TV Ratings. Please see https://www.nielsen.com/digitalprivacy for more information

Terms of Use:  https://legal.paramount.com/us/en/cbsi/terms-of-use
Paramount Privacy Policy: https://privacy.paramount.com/policy
Minors' Privacy Policy: https://privacy.paramount.com/en/childrens
